basic_info.description: Discover this stunning late-midcentury home, built in 1973, located in Portola's highly desirable University Mound. The inviting open floor plan seamlessly connects the living and dining areas to a flat backyard and garden, perfect for outdoor enjoyment. The updated kitchen features granite countertops, while dual pane windows flood the home with natural light. Recent upgrades include new light fixtures and fresh paint. The main level features a convenient half bath and a 2-car garage with interior access. Upstairs, you'll find 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 modern bathrooms. The backyard offers an ideal space for family gatherings.     Enjoy proximity to John McLaren Park with its trails, playgrounds, and open green spaces. With easy access to I-280, commuting to San Francisco or Silicon Valley is effortless. Conveniently located near shops, parks, and major transit routes, this home is ready for its next owners to enjoy. Don't miss this incredible opportunity to own a home in one of San Francisco's most charming neighborhoods.
